title: Add a widget to your dashboard
blurb: Track the numbers you care about, like leads by source or deals won.

steps.title: Switch to edit mode
steps.body: Click the pencil icon at the top right of the dashboard.

steps.title: Add a widget
steps.tip: Don't see **Add Widget**? Click **Edit dashboard** first.

steps.title: Pick a chart type
steps.body: Choose how to show it: **Numeric** for a single number, or **Bar**, **Line**, **Donut** or **Table** for a breakdown. Then pick what it measures, such as contacts, opportunities or conversations.

steps.title: Narrow it down
steps.body: Give it a clear title. If you only want some records, add conditions, for example pipeline is Sales or tag is new-lead.

steps.title: Save the widget
steps.body: Click **Save**. Then drag it into place, resize it from the corner, and save your changes to the dashboard.
